outline: 此課程為研究所初級課程，主要以三個方面介紹線性規劃：數學模型建立、演算法與原理、對偶理論及敏感度分析。
schedule:
Week 1. Introduction of Operations Research and Optimization Models
Week 2. Linear Programming Modeling
Week 3. Linear Programming Modeling
Week 4. Linear Programming Modeling
Week 5. Geometry and Algebra of Linear Programming
Week 6. Simplex Method
Week 7. Simplex Method
Week 8. Simplex Method
Week 9. Midterm Exam
Week 10. Duality and Sensitivity Analysis
Week 11. Duality and Sensitivity Analysis
Week 12. Duality and Sensitivity Analysis
Week 14. Data Envelopment Analysis and Its Application
Week 15. Data Envelopment Analysis and Its Application
Week 16. Data Envelopment Analysis and Its Application
Week 17. Other LP Applications
Week 18. Final Exam or Term Paper
assessment:
Homework Assignments: 30%
Mid-term Exam: 25%
Reading Report: 20%
Final Exam: 25%
